emptyTitle: A little room for your photos.
emptySubtitle: Drop photos here to frame them for export.
thicknessError: Enter a whole number from 0 to 50 for thickness.
longEdgeError: Enter a long edge from 1 to 100,000 pixels.
qualityError: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100 for JPEG quality.
photosKeyboardHelp: Use the Left and Right Arrow keys to select a photo. Press Delete to remove it.
metadataHelp: Includes camera details and location when present.
sizeHelp: Photo size before the border. Smaller photos are never enlarged.
formatHelp: Exports keep the source file format and color profile. JPEG photos are re-encoded when a border is added.

presetError: Presets could not be saved. Check access to AppData and try again.
closeMessage: Photos already exported will remain in the destination folder.
ratioError: Choose Original or a ratio such as 4:5.
unreadableError: This image could not be read.
unsupportedError: Choose a single JPEG, PNG, or TIFF image with 8-bit or 16-bit color.
sourceChangedError: This photo changed after it was added. Add it again or retry to use the updated file.
allocationError: This canvas needs too much memory. Choose a smaller content size.
sameFileError: Choose an output file different from the original.
writeError: The image could not be saved. Check the destination folder.
